decision: The current implementation, design collection, and browser verification categories are sufficient for this release.

tools.name: UI dashboard orchestrator
tools.governance: Dry-run is read-only unless --report-root is explicit and inside project-ui/artifacts or project-ui/reports. Unknown execution classes fail closed; browser, external, and delegated execution require matching allow flags; blocked entry gates reject execution; hosted success remains review-pending.

tools.name: Figma Connector
tools.governance: Use for the first approved exemplar of a page mode and candidate comparison, not as production truth.

tools.name: Playwright scripts with CloakBrowser/Chromium
tools.blocker: No current page-level live run was executed in this audit phase.
tools.governance: Exploration and dry-run configuration are not pass evidence; repeatable assertions, traces, screenshots, console and network results must be written by project-testing.

tools.name: project-testing release cockpit
tools.blocker: A dry-run proves routing/configuration only; no local, CI, staging, or live release verdict was produced.
tools.governance: This is the only page-release cockpit. project-ui must not duplicate it.

tools.name: Browser/Figma MCP tools
tools.governance: Use to investigate or collect candidate evidence, then convert stable findings into versioned scripts or reviewed artifacts.

tools.name: @playwright/test
tools.reason: Direct Playwright and project-testing cover the current audit; do not add a second runner until page implementation demonstrates a missing capability.

tools.name: eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y
tools.reason: @axe-core/playwright covers the current browser path; reassess only if lint-time coverage is required.

tools.name: Lighthouse CI
tools.reason: Add only after stable authenticated staging URLs and performance budgets exist.

tools.name: Style Dictionary
tools.reason: Add only after the runtime token single source of truth is settled; do not create another token source.
